product_metadata.title: Automatic Soap Dispenser, Touchless Stainless Steel Soap Dispenser with Sensor Fingerprint Resistant and Waterproof Base for Kitchen Bathroom Sanitizer Shampoo
features: Adjustable Dispensing Volume: This automatic soap dispenser has 3 different volume settings to adjust the amount of soap you ideal want. 3 volume settings can be done through the switch button(volume control) without dropping or trailing, no waste soap. The dispenser can be filled about 230ml at one time.

Touchless, Sensitive & Easy to Setup: No need to touch Soap Dispenser again, just put your hand under the sensor and no need to wave your hand times, the Smart motion infra-red sensor detects your hand instantly. This Automatic Soap Dispenser will keep you and your family away from bacteria and keep your family safe and healthy.

Durable & Safety: Made with brushed nickel stainless steel, using AAA-level anti-leakage technology to prevent the soap or water to corrode e-components. The waterproof base design is to prevent battery compartment from getting soaked in water which could cause corrosion and the soap dispenser fail to work.

Available for any Soap/Sanitier: You can fill soap (make sure no microbeads), sanitizer or lotion through top cover. No other mounting required. You can also refill lotion easily, save cost and environment.

Wide Applications: It's applicable to the bathroom, kitchen or washroom. Hand santinizer, shampoo, dishwashing detergent or other liquid soap etc. can be refilled and used repeatedly. For liquid flow out more smoothly, make sure no particles etc. which may block the soap nozzle.
description: Discover the ORIGINAL AND BEST easy Automatic Soap Dispenser from VCOO, this is a popular product which combining functional and stylish design, ideal gifts for your families or friends! Assembly Instruction: 1. Place 4pcs AAA batteries in the battery compartment, then assemble cover. 2. Unlock the top cover by turning it anti-clockwise. Fill the sanitizer you want to, then close the cover. Pls make sure the sanitizer/soap does NOT contain solid particles to avoid clogging. 3. To switch on, press and hold the button for 3seconds, when the indicator turns red and flicker, it means workable. By short-pressing button, you can adjust soap volume with low, medium, high 3 volumes liquid. 4. Put your hand under the sensor or close the sensor ( light indicator), the soap will flow out.

1. Please keep the surface of the dispenser clean, wipe the body with mop regularly to avoid long-term corrosion upon it. 2. Do not expose electronics under any circumstances. 3. Do not wash the dispenser or soak it into water or flush it with srong flowing water. 4. Please turn off the dispenser when you need to move it in case any soap flowing out. 5. Please empty sanitizer in the dispenser and take out the batteries if you do not use it for a long time.

Material: Stainless steel and ABS plastic Sensor type: Infrared sensor. Capacity of dispenser: 230ml (8oz) Input Power: 4 AAA Battery (not included) Package Contents: 1 x Soap Dispenser 1 x User Manual  Note: Battery and Soap are not included in this package.
